messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles | California | LAX |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago | Illinois | ORD |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW |
| Denver International Airport | Denver | Colorado | DEN |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City | New York | JFK |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco | California | SFO |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle | Washington | SEA |
| Miami International Airport | Miami | Florida | MIA |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando | Florida | ORL |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger traffic and serve as major hubs for both domestic and international flights.
